name: Aquarium Empire
summary: Aquarium Empire is a free fish tank game where you build your own underwater empire. Buy fish and keep them fed – a hungry fish turns green and a starving fish turns red. Well-fed fish level up from Bronze to Silver, Platinum and Gold and drop coins you tap or swipe to collect. Raise squid and octopuses for gold bars, breed babies with the Mother Fish, earn pots of gold from the Rainbow Fish, and survive pirate ships that fire their cannons into your tank. Pick special characters like the Fisherman, the Mad Scientist and the Pirate Captain, then play Story Mode or race the clock in Crazy Play.
